statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, all of the following hold: (1) len(r) = len(nums); (2) for every integer v, the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(r) and r[i] = v equals the number of indices j with 0 <= j < len(nums) and nums[j] = v; (3) for every index i with 0 <= i < len(r), if i is even then r[i] % 2 = 0, and if i is odd then r[i] % 2 = 1.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 2 and len(nums) <= 20000; len(nums) is even (len(nums) % 2 = 0); the number of indices j with 0 <= j < len(nums) and nums[j] % 2 = 0 is exactly len(nums)/2 (and the number of indices j with nums[j] % 2 = 1 is also len(nums)/2); and for every j with 0 <= j < len(nums), 0 <= nums[j] <= 1000.
